scene: Wind whips your beanie as the flying sidecar zooms over neon towers.
beats: The dial hums with static, tuning right into the flashing storefront as the sidecar glides inside and the doors slide open.
The mechanical pigeon drops a warm, glowing vacuum tube into your lap just as the motorbike rolls inside and the garage doors open.
You find a coiled copper wire that hums cheerfully, matching the shop's neon glow as the sidecar halts inside and the bay doors open.
picture: A flat side view inside the flying sidecar motorbike. Far left: dashboard with a glowing brass dial. Centre: the player sits inside, gripping the padded rim beside a canvas sack on the floor. Right: the goggled motorcycle driver sits astride, while a clockwork pigeon flaps just beyond.
shown: A brass tuning dial clicks quietly on the dashboard on the far left.
A clockwork pigeon glides steadily beside the open sidecar on the right.
A rumpled canvas tool sack sits unopened on the floor at the centre.

after.label: Step off at Midnight Radio Repair
Stay on
after.beat: You wave Midnight Radio Repair goodbye as a neon banner ruffles your beanie. At the line's end, you board the clanking bridge crawler, trundling toward the turning cog towers of bustling Gear Bridge.

variants.scene: Cool night air rushes past as you cruise across the glittering skyline.
beats: A clear radio melody crackles to life from the dashboard speaker just as the sidecar touches down and the depot doors open.
The fluttering mechanical bird drops a bright vacuum tube into your hand right as the motorbike rolls inside and the sliding doors open.
Your fingers pull out a springy copper coil from the bag just as the sidecar settles onto the floor and the big doors open.
variants.ride_on: You breeze past Midnight Radio Repair with a friendly wave. At the end of the line, you hop onto a clanking bridge crawler bound for the whirring towers of Gear Bridge.

variants.scene: Stars twinkle above purple skies while your sidecar hums through the city.
beats: Faint station chatter resolves into cheerful music as the sidecar steers smoothly inside and the glass entrance doors open.
The clockwork flyer releases a warm, glowing glass tube neatly into your palms as the motorcycle lands and the hangar doors open.
You unearth a tidy spool of copper wire from the pouch just as the sidecar glides to a stop and the wide doors open.
variants.ride_on: Leaving Midnight Radio Repair behind in the neon glow, you ride to the final stop and climb aboard a clattering bridge crawler headed straight for bustling Gear Bridge.

variants.scene: Your corduroy coat rustles while humming {tune} above the purple towers.
beats: The needle swings and broadcasts a crisp broadcast chime right as the sidecar slips indoors and the garage entrance doors open.
A gleaming vacuum tube falls gently into your lap from the mechanical pigeon just as the bike parks and the shop doors open.
You fish out a buzzing bundle of copper wire right as the sidecar coasts onto the ramp and the steel doors open.
variants.ride_on: You watch Midnight Radio Repair fade into the distance. At the final platform, you transfer to the lumbering bridge crawler that clanks right up toward Gear Bridge.
